ai_title: Dancing on the ISS Sets the Tone for a Great Week
ai_summary: Astronauts on the International Space Station share their passion for music by dancing to their favorite tunes in space. This heartwarming video captures the spirit of unity and joy that music brings, transcending cultural and geographical boundaries. As we celebrate the beauty of music, we explore its role in shaping our lives and connecting us to the world.
caption: Volume up and get your groove on! A bit of weekend dancing on the @iss to start your week off right. A friend of mine was shocked when she realized that it was possible to dance in microgravity. Seems we can’t keep this from the world for any longer! The power of music transcends Earth and space.

hook: NASA is inbound to the NFL.
transcript: NASA is inbound to the NFL. This season, we're bringing the excitement of American exploration to stadiums across the country. We have NASA flyovers, tailgates, astronaut meet and greets, and immersive experience zones that put the future of space flight right in front of the next generation. Because somewhere in those stands is an engineer, a pilot, scientist or astronaut, and all they need to do is look up and imagine the possibilities. This season, we're bringing NASA to the fans, the families, and the next generation as they join us on the greatest adventure in human history.
ai_title: NASA Takes the Field with Exciting Football Flyover in Pittsburgh
ai_summary: In a thrilling collaboration, NASA brings its cutting-edge technology and American exploration spirit to the gridiron, connecting with football fans and their families through a series of special events and experiences.
caption:
Today’s @nfl flyover in Pittsburgh is just the beginning.

This is how @nasa does game day. 🇺🇸
